label: Sparse: anatomy, physiology and biochemistry content words in explanatory biology or medical prose, often the subword that completes a technical term. Examples are body structures, tissues and organs (genic|ulate body, lymph|atic tissue, serous sac, plant roots, fores|kin, peripheral parts), minerals and elements (arsen|ic, zinc, bor|on, tann|ic acid), and bodily conditions or processes (osteodyst|rophy, injuries, inherited condition, dissolves). It is multilingual (English, Russian, Arabic, Japanese).
